value.name: everyone returns to dining room
value.description: The family is called back to the dining room, bringing the estate meeting back into a tense shared space.
evidence: Everyone is called back to the dining room.
The estate meeting turns into a confrontation over what the dead intended and what the living can bear to hear.

value.name: Lucia opposes selling house
value.description: Lucia argues that the house should not be sold because their mother invested her heart in it and wanted it protected.
evidence: Lucia: "I can't stand by and watch this house be sold off like it means nothing—our mother poured her heart into every corner of it, and I believe she wanted us to protect that love, not erase it!"

value.name: Lucia presents mother's letter
value.description: Lucia reveals that she found a letter claiming their mother wanted the house safeguarded for the loyal family member.
evidence: Lucia: "I found a letter, and it speaks to her wishes; she wanted this place to be safeguarded for the one who remained loyal to it—how can we ignore that?"

value.name: room falls silent
value.description: Lucia's revelation silences the room as the family absorbs the implications of the letter.
evidence: The room falls silent, the weight of Lucia's words sinking in.

value.name: Asha urges careful consideration
value.description: Asha acknowledges the letter and asks everyone to think carefully about what it means for the family's legacy.
evidence: Asha: "Lucia, thank you for sharing that letter; it adds a profound layer to our discussion, and I urge everyone to consider its implications carefully—this isn't just about property; it's about honoring a legacy that binds you all."

value.name: Daniel rejects letter as irrelevant
value.description: Daniel dismisses the letter and insists the house must be sold because the family cannot afford to keep it.
evidence: Daniel: "That letter is just words on paper, Lucia; it doesn’t change the fact that this house is a financial burden we can’t afford to keep—it’s time to face reality instead of clinging to sentimental fantasies."

value.name: Rosa defends mother's legacy
value.description: Rosa counters Daniel by framing the house as a testament to their mother's love and urging the family to honor it.
evidence: Rosa: "Daniel, those words carry the weight of our mother’s love; this house is not merely a financial burden—it is a testament to her spirit, and we must honor that before we let it slip through our fingers."

value.name: Lucia confronts Daniel
value.description: Lucia directly challenges Daniel for dismissing their mother's love and insists the house is a living memory she will not surrender.
